designs.title: A · 会话气泡
designs.description: 两段会话组成同一个标识
designs.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: ONE original standalone brand icon candidate for CLI Worker Now, a plugin grouping and visualizing conversations with multiple CLI agents. This is an ORIGINAL LOGO EXPLORATION, not an application screenshot.
The previous icon was rejected for looking too much like Codex. Absolute constraints: NO terminal window, NO command prompt, NO > character, NO underscore, NO flower, NO cloud, NO OpenAI knot, NO sparkle/star, NO blue square containing a white terminal glyph, NO collection of miniature app windows. Do NOT imitate another CLI brand.
Style: very simple FLAT graphic, solid opaque color shapes, crisp vector-like contour, balanced geometry, soft deliberate corner radii, high small-size recognition at 24/32 pixels. Clean sophisticated software identity. No gradient, no 3D, no shadows, no lighting, no embossing, no grain or texture. No words, no labels, no decorative outline, no watermark.
Composition: one centered icon on a square canvas, roughly 78% canvas occupancy with generous consistent transparent margins. True transparent alpha background and transparent negative spaces, not a checkerboard image and not a colored tile. No presentation board.
Palette: solid medium blue #4176E6, optional small light-blue #76A3EE accent as specified. No opaque white backdrop. Design must remain identifiable by silhouette alone.
Concept A — Conversation bridge. Design a compact original emblem made from TWO interleaving thick speech-bubble contours, arranged along a gentle lower-left to upper-right diagonal, facing opposite ways. One main bubble and one smaller reply, echoing parent and child conversations. Use rounded, nearly square loops with open transparent centers, a very short integrated angular speech tail on each. The two loops meet elegantly through a clean negative-space separation so they read as two cooperating conversations, NOT a chain link or infinity symbol. Main loop #4176E6, smaller loop #76A3EE. Geometry is broad and bold with minimum details; no text, no dots or chat lines inside. A memorable cohesive outline, not two disjoint generic message icons.

Concept B — Delegation tree. All branches form one purposeful, compact silhouette, not a sprawling organizational-chart diagram. All three children must clearly connect to the parent. Uniform strong medium blue #4176E6, the middle child alone may be light blue #76A3EE. Generous clean transparent gaps between child nodes. The icon should feel like a simple proprietary worker-routing symbol. Strong visible round corners, no thin wires, no labels, no circles around the tree, no enclosing badge.

designs.description: 将 Worker 化为简洁的字母标识
designs.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: ONE original standalone brand icon candidate for CLI Worker Now, a plugin grouping and visualizing conversations with multiple CLI agents. This is an ORIGINAL LOGO EXPLORATION, not an application screenshot.
The previous icon was rejected for looking too much like Codex. Absolute constraints: NO terminal window, NO command prompt, NO > character, NO underscore, NO flower, NO cloud, NO OpenAI knot, NO sparkle/star, NO blue square containing a white terminal glyph, NO collection of miniature app windows. Do NOT imitate another CLI brand.
Style: very simple FLAT graphic, solid opaque color shapes, crisp vector-like contour, balanced geometry, soft deliberate corner radii, high small-size recognition at 24/32 pixels. Clean sophisticated software identity. No gradient, no 3D, no shadows, no lighting, no embossing, no grain or texture. No words, no labels, no decorative outline, no watermark.
Composition: one centered icon on a square canvas, roughly 78% canvas occupancy with generous consistent transparent margins. True transparent alpha background and transparent negative spaces, not a checkerboard image and not a colored tile. No presentation board.
Palette: solid medium blue #4176E6, optional small light-blue #76A3EE accent as specified. No opaque white backdrop. Design must remain identifiable by silhouette alone.
Concept C — Worker monogram. Design a bespoke single geometric capital W as a compact original app brand mark. A wide, bold continuous zigzag band with gently rounded outer ends and corners forms a clean upright W. Two deep transparent upward valleys and one central high join make it instantly read as W, not M. The left descending arm and central body use solid blue #4176E6; the final rising right arm is a separate solid light blue #76A3EE segment separated by a tiny clean diagonal gap, suggesting independent workers contributing to one unit. This is a planar cut-shape monogram, NOT a folded ribbon: no gradients, overlap shadows or dimensional fold edges. Subtle asymmetric rhythm, uniform thick band width, distinctive but very simple, no other symbols or extra dots. No outside frame or tile. The W itself is the entire icon.
